দক্ষিণাবর্ত ভ্রামক = বামাবর্ত ভ্রামক: 60 x 3 = F x 2, তাই F = 180 ÷ 2 = 90 N।

You need less force to turn the door

The moment becomes too big and the crane can topple

Why are arches usually made of stone or concrete?
Arches carry load mainly in compression, where these are strong
Roman stone arches have stood for 2,000 years.

Its tiny edge area makes huge pressure
Same force, smaller area, much bigger pressure.

Why do heavy cranes and tanks use wide tracks instead of wheels on soft ground?
